## Conflicts noticed

- Rich text needed for progressive summarization (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/235#Comment_235) vs keep notes in plain text only, avoid other formats (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/294#Comment_294)
- Zettelkasten holds both ideas and project items (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/40/hello-zettelnerden) vs keep tasks and organization out of the archive (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/165#Comment_165)
- Starting filenames with the UID is essential (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/843#Comment_843) vs UID at start of filename is a deal breaker on phones (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/862#Comment_862)
- Starting filenames with the UID is essential (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/843#Comment_843) vs keep UID in metadata header, not filename (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/836#Comment_836)
- Surrounding context is enough to know what an ID link points to (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/836#Comment_836) vs context around an ID link only lets you guess; use title links (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/837#Comment_837)
- Linking by title is vulnerable to link rot (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/843#Comment_843) vs rare renames are handled by batch search-and-replace (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/862#Comment_862)
- Put everything including to-do lists into the Zettelkasten (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/211#Comment_211) vs keep tasks out of the archive (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/165#Comment_165)
- Timestamp ID as filename is all that is needed (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/211#Comment_211) vs same author later: no need for IDs (08-1447, https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/832#Comment_832)
- [[UID]] links are app-specific, not agnostic (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/13349#Comment_13349) vs UID linking works with any OS file search (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/13370#Comment_13370)
- Needing to reread means first reading was faulty (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/272#Comment_272) vs rereading yields more as knowledge grows (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/726#Comment_726)
- Rich text conveys more, use it for Zettel (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/726#Comment_726) vs never depend on proprietary format; plain text only (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/343#Comment_343)
- Zettelkasten as contribution tool, not learning tool (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/1930#Comment_1930) vs Zettelkasten is for learning (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/1931#Comment_1931)
- Much highlighting is pseudo-work (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/66/a-short-jordan-peterson-clip-on-processing-reading-lectures) vs mark up the book and index it on each reading (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/726#Comment_726)
- Skip internal note links in favor of strict atomicity (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/285#Comment_285) vs Every note pointing onward to related notes makes retrieval and branching work (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/304#Comment_304)
- Think a minute before each note, keep minute-resolution IDs (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/607#Comment_607) vs Notes get created in rapid succession, so add seconds to IDs (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/606#Comment_606)
- Avoid IDs of different lengths (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/609#Comment_609) vs Suffix colliding IDs with .1, .2 (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/681#Comment_681)
- Link the source right in the note text (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/289#Comment_289) vs Keep references hidden in a comment / metadata so text stays undisturbed (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/627#Comment_627)
- knowledge must be verified in reality (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/13808#Comment_13808) vs no epistemic requirement to prove recorded understanding (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/13810#Comment_13810)
- key-value tags may be a beginner's mistake (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/485#Comment_485) vs use status key-value tags like #subs:out (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/87/techniques-for-tag-heirarchies)
- summarizing others' writing in notes is of doubtful value (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/81/in-which-i-ask-myself-does-building-a-second-brain-distract-from-doing-hard-work-in-my-real-brain) vs mark text to build a narrativised summary turned into a zettel (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/494#Comment_494)
- numeric/timestamp IDs in filenames are a big plus (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/1534#Comment_1534) vs date-time-first filenames confuse human-readable organization (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2405#Comment_2405)
- Only add a note when you know how to link it into the web (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/691#Comment_691) vs overthinking inclusion risks no note; you can't predict connections (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/739#Comment_739)
- ZK suits a graph, not project management, which suits hierarchy (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/761#Comment_761) vs project management should use ZK-like network structure (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/760#Comment_760)
- Use buffer notes vs just tag the notes instead (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/849#Comment_849) vs buffer note as a visible cushion at the top of the archive (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3272#Comment_3272)
- two-digit-year IDs fine, fixable later by macro (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/1092#Comment_1092) vs use four-digit years to avoid rollover disaster (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/1110#Comment_1110)
- links should be UID only so titles can change (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2516#Comment_2516) vs title-based links are self-documenting (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/146/feature-discussion-linking-to-notes-using-uids-inside-the-notes)
- prefix filenames with subject, no UID (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/921#Comment_921) vs give zettels surrogate-key IDs and link by ID (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/781#Comment_781)
- per-note timestamp IDs are cumbersome, ID per topic (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/1832#Comment_1832) vs surrogate-key ID per zettel (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/781#Comment_781)
- one pass cannot extract a text's value, re-read as needed (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/1156#Comment_1156) vs fully process material rather than keep it unprocessed (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/1067#Comment_1067)
- start with structure notes from the beginning, not top-down (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/15443#Comment_15443) vs wait for ~500 notes and let structure emerge (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/15437#Comment_15437)
- structure notes give organic direction from the start (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/15447#Comment_15447) vs structure notes impose structure contrary to organic linking (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/15461#Comment_15461)
- tags are a waste of time, hubs replace them (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/4879#Comment_4879) vs tags plus hubs combined with search operators are useful (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/4892#Comment_4892)
- include seconds in timestamp IDs for uniqueness (08-1514, https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/1842#Comment_1842) vs 12-digit IDs already too long, use shorter YYMM+sequence (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/187/zettel-id)
- capture all writing, value emerges later through refinement (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/1237#Comment_1237) vs keep ephemeral notes out of the slipbox, only developed takeaways go in (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2903#Comment_2903)
- capture all writing, value emerges later (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/1237#Comment_1237) vs be judicious, no notes on every chapter (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/11918#Comment_11918)
- argonsnorts titles notes with colons (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/1448#Comment_1448) vs rene avoid colons in titles for portability (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/1449#Comment_1449)
- one large literature note per source in the reference manager (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/1565#Comment_1565) vs store literature notes as individual items (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/1566#Comment_1566)
- separate topical Zettelkästen for better signal/noise (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/1342#Comment_1342) vs abandon folders for one single archive (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/1551#Comment_1551)
- one single archive (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/1551#Comment_1551) vs three loosely interrelated archives (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/252/the-zettelkasten-method-applied-to-systems-thinking)
- tags should form a semantic map of all subjects (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/1551#Comment_1551) vs tags only on entry-point Zettels (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/1560#Comment_1560)
- collect all quotes from an author into one note (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/1569#Comment_1569) vs one quote per note (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/1570#Comment_1570)
- careful reading ends in Anki cards (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/5267#Comment_5267) vs Anki time better spent on the Zettelkasten (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/259/blog-post-authors-personal-book-digestion-process)
- manual backlinks are wasted effort (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/5982#Comment_5982) vs links should be symmetric, B should mention A (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/6197#Comment_6197)
- plain text impractical, use Bear (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/1733#Comment_1733) vs plain text practical and resilient (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3939#Comment_3939)
- ID-prefixed titles hurt quick switching, omit them (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/1704#Comment_1704) vs prepend timestamp ID to every title (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/1736#Comment_1736)
- throw anything into the ZK (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/1752#Comment_1752) vs exclude context-dependent, fast-changing notes (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/1774#Comment_1774)
- take notes on everything you read (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/1752#Comment_1752) vs don't be an exhaustive note-taker (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/1852#Comment_1852)
- notes must be regular markdown, proprietary format is a deal breaker (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/1808#Comment_1808) vs any simple structured text format is fine (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/1809#Comment_1809)
- tags plus saved search replace structure notes (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/1894#Comment_1894) vs topic connections belong in structure notes, not tags (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/18916#Comment_18916)
- flexible multi-parent hierarchy, no structure notes needed (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/316/thoughts-on-folgezettel) vs rework anchor notes into structure notes (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/17706#Comment_17706)
- tags for concepts, notes only for claims (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2920#Comment_2920) vs keep notes even for easily understood concepts as anchors (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/17706#Comment_17706)
- topic tags are provisional, object tags durable (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/18916#Comment_18916) vs topic tags more useful than object tags (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/22452#Comment_22452)
- role-differentiated person tags (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3309#Comment_3309) vs one tag per person, distinctions elsewhere (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/18916#Comment_18916)
- namespaced/prefixed tags (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/1874#Comment_1874) vs tags long enough to be unambiguous, no tool-specific tricks (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/1792#Comment_1792)
- keep all reference/capture data for a book in one ID+prepend-tag note (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/1946#Comment_1946) vs break a book's notes into many same-title notes per one-note-one-idea (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/1947#Comment_1947)
- give a sub-part of a note its own intra-zettel ID and link to it in place (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/1882#Comment_1882) vs 08-932 split any part you want to link to into its own zettel (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2020#Comment_2020)
- prefer adding corrections over editing wrong notes (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/337/handling-wrong-information-in-the-archive) vs freely edit or totally rewrite misrepresenting reference notes (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/1914#Comment_1914)
- avoid formats that lock the ZK into one editor (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2111#Comment_2111) vs living inside Emacs for all writing is fine (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2114#Comment_2114)
- write zettels as you read (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2038#Comment_2038) vs take non-permanent notes first, permanent notes after (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/1980#Comment_1980)
- building a ZK means developing an argument through note sequences, citing Lüdecke (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2124#Comment_2124) vs building paper outlines through note sequences is misused effort (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2125#Comment_2125)
- building a ZK means developing an argument through note sequences, citing Lüdecke (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2124#Comment_2124) vs Folgezettel not worth replicating digitally (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2128#Comment_2128)
- drop timestamp IDs from zettels, they are noise (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2242#Comment_2242) vs without timestamps or index numbers associative structure depends on tool export (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2243#Comment_2243)
- numbering zettels is unnecessary (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3019#Comment_3019) vs keep numeric IDs for order and sub-zettels (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3755#Comment_3755)
- timestamps useful since related zettels are created around the same time (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2245#Comment_2245) vs temporal relations between zettels are the weakest (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/374/focussing-on-the-kasten-in-zettelkasten)
- proprietary store poses little risk (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2242#Comment_2242) vs plain text essential, full control means editing in place (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2275#Comment_2275)
- zettelkasten links should be bidirectional (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3443#Comment_3443) vs backlinks not needed, place links manually where needed (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3446#Comment_3446)
- abandoning the branching sequence structure for tag retrieval loses something (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/4292#Comment_4292) vs Folgezettel IDs are a kludge, use nesting and links (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/4296#Comment_4296)
- keyword index is valuable beyond full-text search (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/410/keyword-list) vs keyword list is mostly redundant since search finds the terms (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/12918#Comment_12918)
- drawings should be first-class note elements (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/421/image-based-notes) vs transcribe scanned/visual notes into plain text (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2912#Comment_2912)
- add an abstract level between title and body (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/423/another-content-level-the-abstract) vs just make the title longer (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2273#Comment_2273)
- completely digesting a source you may never use is wasted time (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2356#Comment_2356) vs you can't know in advance which part matters, so digest it (08-1648, https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2362#Comment_2362)
- keep flagged material in a no-commitment slushpile outside the ZK (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2374#Comment_2374) vs get content into the Zettelkasten quickly (Eurobubba's own reading of Luhmann, same post)
- keep a separate archive for fiction (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2338#Comment_2338) vs keep fiction in the one ZK, separated by tags (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/6825#Comment_6825)
- keep story development out of the main ZK (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2335#Comment_2335) vs blend fiction and research in one ZK (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/7223#Comment_7223)
- one ZK per fictional world (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/6824#Comment_6824) vs separate ZKs per fiction project imply massive overhead (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/6929#Comment_6929)
- keep metadata at the top of the note (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2422#Comment_2422) vs put all metadata at the end (08-978, https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2386#Comment_2386)
- place a backlink in the target note when linking (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3788#Comment_3788) vs two-way links are pointless since a UID link is a search (08-984, https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2428#Comment_2428)
- keep tags in a YAML block (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2319#Comment_2319) vs skip YAML since its lines waste space (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2419#Comment_2419)
- separate bib files per project (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/452/handling-references-with-bibtex-biblatex-the-archive-and-emacs) vs one central bib file with project tags (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3699#Comment_3699)
- Keep notes in plain text because nothing is more portable (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2563#Comment_2563) vs prefer high-fidelity zettels with media over plain-text 'prepper mentality' (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2641#Comment_2641)
- Put full reference at the bottom of each content zettel (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2596#Comment_2596) vs citekey plus .bib file is enough, no bibliography data in the note (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2697#Comment_2697)
- A zettel is written with atomicity in mind (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/9290#Comment_9290) vs one concept need not be expressed by a single note (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/9243#Comment_9243)
- Do not create orphans, start every note as a link from another (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2529#Comment_2529) vs add links only when a note is used in producing a paper (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2530#Comment_2530)
- tag notes by type (theory, model, definition...) (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/573/idea-for-categorizing-theory-models-definitions-arguments-and-facts) vs type tags have no relevance, tag only by theme when used (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2829#Comment_2829)
- notes should carry images (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/551/feature-request-image-support) vs keep notes plain text and only link images to avoid distraction (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/559/quickly-copy-files-images-to-media-folder-and-create-formatted-media-links-using-keyboard-maestro)
- use titles instead of IDs / title links fine if tool auto-updates (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/564/id-zettel-only-title-not-number, https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/8819#Comment_8819) vs always link by UID only since names change (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/584/feature-request-copy-only-uid)
- structured IDs encoding type/topic (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/613/zettel-id-and-general-unique-identifiers) vs keep context out of the ID, use 12-digit timestamps (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2914#Comment_2914)
- short 6-digit counter IDs (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/598/zettel-id-format) vs 12-digit timestamps (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2914#Comment_2914)
- ~300 words max (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2732#Comment_2732) vs fits on screen without scrolling (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2734#Comment_2734) vs under 700 characters (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/2839#Comment_2839)
- link by UIDs so titles can change without breaking links (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/5330#Comment_5330) vs link by full titles, fix renames via find and replace (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/5337#Comment_5337)
- fuzzy full-text search can replace links (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3040#Comment_3040) vs connect your thoughts, linking is the core advantage (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/625/the-zettelkasten-as-a-lattice-of-thought-strings)
- handwritten notes beat typed notes for understanding (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/645/is-a-handwritten-zettelkasten-better-for-conceptual-understanding; also https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/12466#Comment_12466) vs medium has little influence on comprehension (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/12468#Comment_12468)
- keep personal/non-knowledge notes out of the ZK (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3206#Comment_3206) vs keep personal and professional in one big system (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3365#Comment_3365)
- include full citation in the note (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3316#Comment_3316) vs only citekeys on notes (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3376#Comment_3376)
- tag list is a better entry point than structure/hub notes (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/22598#Comment_22598) vs index points only to entry points reached via connections (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/636/indexing)
- Permanent notes all in one language; dislike mixed-language Zettelkasten (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3511#Comment_3511) vs notes in several languages enrich a Zettelkasten (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3560#Comment_3560)
- Translate all notes into one language (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3507#Comment_3507) vs keep notes untranslated in original languages, tags in one language (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3582#Comment_3582)
- Prefer tags over structure notes (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3581#Comment_3581) vs don't tag content words, leave that to structure notes (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3513#Comment_3513)
- Abundant topic tags define search contexts (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/15106#Comment_15106) vs tags only for language, other tags decay; use keyword notes (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/22087#Comment_22087)
- Replace object tags with a note per tag linked instead (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/4245#Comment_4245) vs tag central zettels on a concept with topic tags (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/716/what-do-people-use-tags-for-in-a-zettelkasten)
- Link by unique ID only, never title (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/701/a-question-re-copying-links-to-notes) vs title-based wiki links that auto-update make timestamp IDs unnecessary (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3547#Comment_3547)
- Skim books for question-relevant parts only and revisit when interests change (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3375#Comment_3375) vs read whole text first without notes then summarise (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3460#Comment_3460)
- Keep many thoughts in one question note, split only when complex (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3501#Comment_3501) vs wide-topic notes fail; use concise-statement atomic notes (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3505#Comment_3505)
- Taking 'single proposition per zettel' too seriously is a mistake (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3534#Comment_3534) vs core notes should contain only one idea (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3535#Comment_3535)
- Notes should be more than a single sentence or proposition (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3537#Comment_3537) vs single lines are the atomic units of meaning (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/787/roam-research)
- Luhmann's branching IDs are essential to gain the method's benefits (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/761/luhmann-s-use-of-unique-ids) vs Luhmann's IDs were an analog technicality digital systems don't need (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3593#Comment_3593)
- Timestamp filenames hide relationships, prefer Luhmann-style IDs (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/13495#Comment_13495) vs use timestamp UID + title exclusively and ignore Luhmann IDs (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/13498#Comment_13498)
- Filenames as UID then title (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/13498#Comment_13498) vs title first then UID (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/21847#Comment_21847) (same poster, years apart)
- Keep separate archives as incubation chambers and for privacy (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3661#Comment_3661) vs separate archives make crosslinking unmanageable, use tags in one archive (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3817#Comment_3817)
- Spreadsheets and project work do not belong in a Zettelkasten (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3800#Comment_3800) vs keep all thinking material in one place (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3804#Comment_3804)
- Create Zettels much earlier in the process (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3820#Comment_3820) vs gather notes on cards and group them before making a summary note (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3845#Comment_3845)
- Sequences/child notes are tighter than links (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3528#Comment_3528) vs a child note is just a link like any other (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3531#Comment_3531)
- Time-based UID unnecessary; file name is the UID (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3884#Comment_3884) vs use timestamp UID so titles can change freely (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3893#Comment_3893)
- Unambiguous links need unique IDs; a link must not be a search (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3887#Comment_3887) vs ambiguous links are the essence of the method (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3889#Comment_3889)
- A static filename-forced map aids navigation (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3935#Comment_3935) vs search beats enforced structure; use a TOC note (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3937#Comment_3937)
- No point splitting a historical narrative into atomic notes (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/831/zettelkasten-mostly-for-knowledge-collection) vs atomize a continuous timeline so it can be linked into (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3994#Comment_3994)
- Write survey wiki first, then chunk it into the Zettelkasten (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3998#Comment_3998) vs start with atomic notes, then write long-form (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3999#Comment_3999)
- Contextual backlinks are more useful (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/4013#Comment_4013) vs automatic contextual backlinks add noise; create backlinks by hand (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/4587#Comment_4587)
- Use [[...]] links instead of tags for auto connections (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/4600#Comment_4600) vs WikiLinks for single notes, tags for groups (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3863#Comment_3863)
- Don't change existing zettels; create new ones instead (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/4149#Comment_4149) vs update old notes with new thinking; half the work is editing (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/4214#Comment_4214)
- Tags easier to maintain than TOC/structure notes (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/4073#Comment_4073) vs create TOC notes per topic instead of numbering (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/4071#Comment_4071)
- Date IDs annoying, use descriptive names (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/849/questioning-some-original-zettelkasten-practices) vs IDs essential for stable links (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/4094#Comment_4094)
- UUID as primary key is most portable (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/4673#Comment_4673) vs UUID references limit portability (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/4109#Comment_4109)
- Don't write essays as zettels, clutters search (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/4208#Comment_4208) vs include own published articles in ZK (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/4214#Comment_4214)
- Every note needs a conceptual link via a concept note (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/4168#Comment_4168) vs put relationship info in the note itself (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/4180#Comment_4180)
- Quick unpolished notes worth capturing (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/4075#Comment_4075) vs only full ideas go into the ZK (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/4074#Comment_4074)
- Keep external files intermingled in one media dir (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/4206#Comment_4206) vs separate images from other docs (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/873/link-external-files-feedback-request)
- structure notes are the top-level entry points (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/4249#Comment_4249) vs reliance on structured hub notes recreates category-tag problems; index should point to one entry note only (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/4284#Comment_4284)
- tag at creation with future-search keywords (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/4262#Comment_4262) vs don't tag at creation, add tags later as connections appear (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/4345#Comment_4345)
- don't change a note's meaning after linking it (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/4282#Comment_4282) vs iterate on and rework zettels until finished (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/4467#Comment_4467)
- branch whenever there is a new idea (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/4255#Comment_4255) vs factual historical content needs little branching (https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/4243#Comment_4243)

## Coverage log

Method for every row: Vanilla forum API v2 on forum.zettelkasten.de, anonymous, throttled to one request per 1.5 s. Enumeration: `GET /api/v2/discussions?limit=100&page=1..31&sort=discussionID&expand=insertUser` (opening posts in full). Replies: `GET /api/v2/comments?discussionID={id}&limit=100&page=N&expand=insertUser` until a short page. Every thread below was read in full; status `read-no-claims` means every post was read and none made a claim about note quality or construction. Staff posts (Sascha, ctietze; ticket #7) and the `System` bot were read for context only. Claims already in tickets #7 or #8 were not re-added; the note column names prior ids where they apply.

## Known gaps

- Sweep stopped early: the user wrapped up gathering on 2026-11-04. 2390 of 3057 enumerated discussions were not reached; each has a `failed` coverage row with the note "not reached: wrapped up per user 2026-11-04".
- Enumeration: the anonymous listing (`GET /api/v2/discussions?sort=discussionID`, 31 pages) returned 3057 unique discussions with ids 7 to 3581, while its `x-app-page-result-count` header said 3025 and the sum of `countDiscussions` in `GET /api/v2/categories` was 2992. The listing includes categories 14 (88 threads) and 22 (16 threads), which `/api/v2/categories` does not list. The planned per-id probe of the roughly 518 ids missing from the listing (to separate login-gated from deleted threads) was not run before the wrap-up.
- Posters who formatted their own words as a blockquote (with no attribution) could not be quoted until a reader rule change partway through the run; shards s001-s018 were read under the stricter rule, so such passages there may be under-recorded (known cases: Edmund, https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/22802#Comment_22802; mediapathic, https://forum.zettelkasten.de/discussion/comment/3733#Comment_3733).
- Login-gated areas (members-only categories, The Perfect Zettel course) are out of scope for this ticket and were not swept.
- Staff posts (Sascha, ctietze) are ticket #7's and are not recorded here.
